author: VozNativa developer (not independent)
class: skill-only: every arm uses the same model through the same wrapper

arms.B1-one-line: Reescreva para soar mais natural, sem alterar o significado.
arms.B5a-voznativa-prompt: one call with the voznativa rewrite-prompt (no gates, no retries): isolates the prompt
arms.B5b-voznativa-engine: full engine: pattern decision, gates, retries, returns the original when unsafe

wrapper: skill text inside <skill> tags, then the task and the text; every arm asked for the final text inside <final></final>

deterministic: voznativa compare status vs the original
metrics.llm_judge: same judge prompt for every arm (voznativa judge-prompt), kind=llm, separate call
metrics.human: blind pairwise review packets; results only from real reviewers

bias_disclosure: the deterministic instrument and the judge prompt are VozNativa's own; they are applied identically to every arm
rule: the first complete run is the official result; reruns are reported separately, never replace it
